type: retrospective already-consumed development screen, not source first-use, scientific qualification or new native training
question: Can a causally prequential public-context-addressed gate recover archive readout when it is useful, rather than sharing one unstable global posterior across all contexts?
setup: One fixed selector; do not alter the original learner, frozen source, seal, checkpoint, memory, or original result. Reuse already-produced prequential forecasts and revealed outcomes.

algorithm.key: (public_views[0],row.x1); public observable prior to first intervention consequence
algorithm.likelihood: joint Bernoulli likelihood for observed s2 and y from existing archived/live source predictions; exactly RET01 _advance math
algorithm.chronology: score archive/live mixture with key's posterior before each event, then apply that event's witnessed s2,y and update only that key; unknown key uses prior. New trace is scored chronologically; after all new events, old diagnostic trace is scored then updated in its historical order. No phase/world/seed labels may enter gate.
algorithm.negative: RET01 mispaired gate from source, global gate, naive 50-50 mixture, live, archive, chance and fully fitted Beta controls already in trace
algorithm.oracle: Separate unattainable per-event hindsight optimum convex blend is *only* an upper-bound diagnostic; never inputs to gate, controls, training, thresholds or parameter selection.

scoring.new_metric: mean two-bit Brier on late_B + late_return_A, 16 events/seed
scoring.old_metric: 32 previously consumed historical readouts per seed; diagnostic only
scoring.rule: PASS development screen only if all thresholds met on both replicas and exact deterministic/custody tests PASS. A failed threshold is DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. No second model choice or tuning using these same traces.

authority.scope: isolated GitHub research branch and draft only
